blocks.text: The ServiceNow CMDB outegration enables updates to CMDB records, such as adding missing assets, and maintaining an accurate and up-to-date CMDB. This is critical for improving operational efficiency, and strengthening policy compliance and audit readiness.
This article is a step-by-step guide to configuring the ServiceNow CMDB outegration.
Before configuring the outegration, make sure you have met the following prerequisites:

blocks.item: Configure the ServiceNow Assets Connector. To learn more, see Configuring the ServiceNow Connectors.
Ensure that you retrieve the authentication parameters based on the selected authentication method to enter them in the corresponding fields during the outegration setup:
User Name Password Client ID Client Secret

blocks.text: To configure the ServiceNow CMDB outegration, complete the following steps:

blocks.item: Step 1: Authenticate the ServiceNow CMDB Connection (Connect)
Step 2: Configure the Outegration Visibility and Behavior (Settings)
